caveat: M3 context currently reads M1 metadata even in native full mode; a future overlap path must bind immutable metadata and exclusively lease the manager, join before the next precheck/reset, and drain on failure. Existing M1Worker supports precheck only and cannot safely be repurposed without lifecycle changes.
decision: Diagnostic only: do not introduce a second async state system for a small commit-only upper bound. Adapter/precheck/maintenance are not silently removed and cannot all overlap the current decode.
